overlays.notes: Measured 2026-07-13 from the protocol's own stats API: total collateral value $71,324,392 against total BOLD supply 29,047,740 gives a system collateralization ratio of 2.455; Stability Pool deposits of 19,111,283 BOLD against the same supply give a liquidation capacity ratio of 0.658. The dedicated qualitative review on 2026-07-15 used Liquity's current documentation and implementation pinned at commit c8a5a4ee2e9dc024905856b6698a77d849c68c7e. Each branch has its own Stability Pool; liquidation burns deposited BOLD against debt and redistributes any remainder only among active Troves in that branch. That establishes an adequate two-stage backstop and adequate operational branch isolation, while the shared BOLD claim still exposes holders to unrecovered debt from any branch and prevents a strong rating. A branch can permanently shut down below its SCR or on oracle failure, stop interest and new borrower operations, and enable urgent branch redemptions. Liquity's own risk disclosure nevertheless states that collapsed collateral can leave unbacked BOLD with no unconditional recapitalization facility, so shutdown and bad-debt handling is limited. Any BOLD holder can permissionlessly redeem through the CollateralRegistry for a routed mix of collateral at protocol value, with urgent redemption available after branch shutdown, supporting adequate structural redemption.

overlays.notes: Measured on-chain 2026-07-14 at HyperEVM block 40440545 via eth_call. The contract graph was derived on-chain: the feUSD token exposes no Liquity getters (it is a role-gated upgradeable ERC20, not Liquity's BoldToken), so the graph was taken from the CollateralRegistry proxy 0x9de1e57 (impl 0xD06DfC33), whose totalCollaterals() = 4 and getTroveManager(i)/getToken(i) enumerate exactly four branches: WHYPE (TM 0x3100F4e7), UBTC (TM 0xbbe5f227), kHYPE (TM 0x7c07bB77), wstHYPE (TM 0x58446C58). The registry address is corroborated by Felix's own docs, and each TroveManager's activePool() matches the four holders already in the coin file's liveReservesConfig. Per branch, getEntireBranchColl() x PriceFeed.lastGoodPrice() over getEntireBranchDebt(): WHYPE 430,173.636 WHYPE @ $65.20795344 = $28,050,742 vs debt 9,522,352.500 (CR 2.946); UBTC 28.055 @ $62,449.56855 = $1,752,006 vs debt 569,059.981 (CR 3.079); kHYPE 75,231.740 @ $64.98626 = $4,889,029 vs debt 1,123,782.912 (CR 4.351); wstHYPE 10,395.891 @ $65.41448 = $680,042 vs debt 348,425.553 (CR 1.952). System totals: collateral $35,371,819 over total branch debt 11,563,620.946 feUSD = collateralizationRatio 3.059. Cross-checks: (1) Felix's TroveManager has no getTCR(uint256), so collateral was verified three ways — TroveManager.getEntireBranchColl() equals ActivePool.getCollBalance() equals the collateral ERC20's balanceOf(ActivePool) for all four branches (exact, to within 1 wei on WHYPE); (2) re-valuing the same collateral at the live PriceFeed.fetchPrice() instead of lastGoodPrice() gives CR 3.070, agreeing to within 0.4%; (3) total branch debt 11,563,620.946 versus feUSD totalSupply() 11,563,588.435 agree to 0.0003% — supply is 32.51 feUSD BELOW debt, which is the expected direction for Liquity V2 (branch debt includes interest accrued but not yet minted), not a discrepancy. DefiLlama independently reports 11,563,600.69 circulating. liquidationCapacityRatio = sum of StabilityPool.getTotalfeUSDDeposits() (the fork's rename of getTotalBoldDeposits) 9,915,239.353 over total debt = 0.857; each pool's deposits plus getYieldGainsOwed() reconcile exactly against feUSD.balanceOf(StabilityPool), confirming the deposit figure is committed capital actually held, not an accounting claim. IMPORTANT QUALIFIER: Stability Pools are branch-local and cannot cross-subsidize, and coverage is very uneven — UBTC's pool holds 3.572x its own branch debt while wstHYPE holds only 0.238x and WHYPE 0.703x. Capping each branch's usable pool at its own debt gives a branch-isolation-adjusted ratio of 0.731; the reported 0.857 is the brief's uncapped sum-over-total definition and is the optimistic bound. Parameters read on-chain from each BorrowerOperations: MCR 135% / CCR 170% / SCR 120% for WHYPE, kHYPE and wstHYPE, and MCR 125% / CCR 150% / SCR 120% for UBTC. All four branches are live (shutdownTime() = 0) and on their primary oracle (PriceFeed priceSource = 0, i.e. not fallen back to lastGoodPrice). Liquidation penalties are not exposed by any public getter. Felix's docs and pinned implementation establish an independent state contract per branch, a branch-local Stability Pool with residual debt and collateral redistributed only to that branch's active troves, system redemption through the CollateralRegistry, and SCR-triggered branch shutdown with urgent redemption. Backstop and branch isolation are adequate; structural redemption is adequate. Shutdown and bad-debt handling are limited because shutdown, urgent redemption, and redistribution are implemented, but no separate recapitalization facility covers a branch-wide collateral deficit and the documented external control is Anthias monitoring.
